argumentBindings.description: One occurrence binding per declared component parameter. Resource/capability/policy/observation modes take a typed Ref; value mode takes a tagged non-computational StaticValueActual. Unknown modes, wrong actual shape, missing required slots and nominal mismatches must be rejected by semantic checker. Old Expr arguments remain read-only and are forbidden to current Writer.

contextBindings.description: Per-instance bindings for component contextRoles. Separate from static definition argumentBindings; no cross-instance implicit inheritance.

argumentBindings.description: Static template actuals; parameter forwards one already-bound parent template parameter. Runtime constructor values belong only in constructorArguments. All kind, authority and lifetime checks remain required.
